description: Spring Boot OpenTelemetry provides Spring Boot auto-configuration for the core OpenTelemetry SDK, configuring resource attributes, environment-variable-driven SDK properties, and the shared OpenTelemetry instance consumed by other instrumentation modules. It also auto-configures OTLP-based log record export, including Docker Compose and Testcontainers connection details for shipping application logs to collectors such as Grafana or an OpenTelemetry Collector.
